about.metadataDescription: The story behind PIZZATO: fresh dough, honest toppings and pizza made the way Cairo wants it — ordered with one quick call.

hero.title: Made Fresh in Cairo
hero.subtitle: Straightforward pizza: fresh dough every morning, generous toppings, and ordering that takes seconds over the phone.

content.storyParagraph1: PIZZATO started with one simple belief: in a city that loves food this much, pizza should never be dull. So every morning we mix fresh dough, prep our toppings, and bake each pie to order — nothing frozen, nothing pre-made the day before.
content.storyParagraph2: We kept the menu focused and familiar. Vegetarian, cheese, chicken, meat and seafood — each built around big, real ingredients and a crust that earns its place at the table.
content.philosophyParagraph: Good ingredients, cooked well, priced honestly. No gimmicks on the menu and none in the process. If it is on offer, it is made fresh and worth ordering.
content.qualityParagraph: Our dough is proofed fresh daily. Our toppings are portioned generously. And our add-ons are priced by the size you pick — so you always know exactly what you are paying for.

contact.metadataDescription: Reach PIZZATO by phone for orders, questions and directions to our branches in Cairo.

hero.title: Let's Talk Pizza
hero.subtitle: Order, ask, or stop by — we are one call away.
